title: Personal Credit Cards: closing autopay drawn only on an active PCB checking account
content:
# Personal Credit Cards: the checking account that carries a closing autopay

This rule belongs to the Personal Credit Cards line and reads the cardholder's checking accounts. When a cardholder closing a card that will still carry a balance records a closing fixed-amount autopay instruction, it fixes which account the instruction is drawn on and what happens when there is none.

## Rule

1. The closing autopay instruction is drawn on a PCB checking account of the cardholder whose status is active.
2. When the cardholder holds no PCB checking account whose status is active, no closing autopay can be recorded, and the amount is 0.00.

The status is read from the bank's checking account records for the cardholder.

## Branch table

| Cardholder's PCB checking accounts | Closing autopay |
|---|---|
| at least one in active status | drawn on an active PCB checking account of the cardholder |
| none in active status, or none at all | cannot be recorded; amount 0.00 |

## Points of judgement

- A savings account cannot carry the closing autopay; the instruction is drawn on a checking account.
- A checking account of the cardholder that is not active cannot carry it.
- A checking account belonging to someone else cannot carry it; the account must be the cardholder's.
